depictions.name: Kurama Onsen
depictions.text: Kurama Onsen is a hot spring located in Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was situated in the Genbu Highlands in Yamashiro. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the onsen while traveling through the region.
